_what: The parity backlog as a DAG. `needs` names tasks that must be done first; a task with
unmet dependencies is BLOCKED and the loop will not offer it. Specialists mirror the
roles the orchestration pattern assigns: rendering, moveset, engine, pipeline.
GOAL: mechanical parity with Tekken and Schwarzerblitz in how a match actually plays.

tasks.title: Stop the hip collapsing during strikes
tasks.measure: tools/model_diag/lbs_in_play.mjs — median thigh radius must exceed 0.85 of bind
tasks.notes: DQS proved offline to roughly double retained volume (0.23 -> 0.42) but not to fix it alone, so the rest-pose offset below is part of the same defect. Reference implementations: KosRud/DQ-skinning-for-Unity (HLSL), ishmeetkohli/dualQuaternionSkinning (GLSL).

tasks.title: Stop the retarget parking the thigh 81 degrees from bind
tasks.measure: tools/model_diag/rest_offset.mjs — median thigh delta from bind under 40 degrees
tasks.notes: A standing jab measures 74 degrees, which is not anatomy. Suspected rest-pose mismatch between source and canonical binds baked into the thigh track. upf-gti/retargeting-threejs solves joint-level offsets between mismatched binds.

tasks.title: Upper-body moves must not drive the legs
tasks.measure: tools/parity/pelvis_gate.ts — a hand strike must stay within 15 deg of the idle stance envelope, with the same clip played as a kick as the control
tasks.now: 7.2 deg masked vs 94.6 deg unmasked. src/engine/motion/BoneMask.ts, 13 tests, gated in the critic.
tasks.notes: Was blocked on rest-offset on the theory that the offset had to be removed from the clips first. It does not: the engine can decline to read the part of the clip that is wrong. The mask comes from the motion state, never from measuring the corrupt tracks. Kicks, jumps, throws, hits, knockdowns and taunts keep their own legs; crouching strikes borrow the LIVE crouch stance, which is better than the crouch their capture happened to contain.

tasks.title: A cancelled follow-up should skip part of its startup
tasks.measure: the second hit of a string reaches its active frames sooner than when thrown cold
tasks.notes: Tekken's Cancel struct carries starting_frame beside detection_start/end (Kiloutre/TKMovesets). We have no data to fill it; needs a derivation or authored values.
